data.description: At LeveragePoint, I work as a Junior Front-end Software Developer, contributing to both internal and client-facing projects using PHP and Vue.js. My role began with a three-month technical assessment and training program designed to align my skills with the company’s development standards. Since then, I have strengthened my proficiency in Laravel (PHP framework) and expanded my front-end capabilities through ongoing work with Vue.js (JavaScript framework), gaining practical experience in collaborative, team-based development. Notable projects include the JobPoint, where I implemented a new front-end design; the Ecosystem platform, where I focused on delivering an aesthetically pleasing front-end development; and the BDIH PEEPA Hackathon, in which our team placed 4th overall, where I led front-end design efforts. This role has significantly enhanced my problem-solving skills, code quality, and professional communication within a dynamic development environment.

I worked at Kalafhi Medical Center as a Junior Web Developer. I created, designed, and led the development of the websites for Renewal Aesthetics and Kalafhi Medical Center using HTML, CSS, and Javascript, with REST APIs developed using the ASP.Net framework and C#. During this tenure, I implemented my growing skillset in HTML and CSS and improved my social and communication skills in a work setting

During my legal training and work experience, I developed strong skills in debt collection, legal research, and effective communication. Through both academic and practical settings, I learned how to interpret complex legal information, advocate clearly and professionally, and manage sensitive financial matters with diligence and care.

data.description:
Responsibilities at Morupule Coal Mine:

* Assisted in the installation, maintenance, and repair of electrical systems, including motors, switchgear, motor control centres (MCCs), power distribution boards, and lighting circuits within the plant.
* Worked alongside control and instrumentation technicians on the installation, calibration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of plant instrumentation such as weightometers, belt scales, pressure, level, temperature, and flow transmitters.
*installation of underground control instruments 
* Participated in routine inspections, fault-finding, and preventive maintenance schedules for electrical and instrumentation equipment to reduce unplanned downtime.
* Supported plant automation operations, assisting in the configuration, wiring, and troubleshooting of programmable logic controllers (PLC) and interfacing control devices.
* Carried out motor starter panel installations and maintenance, including Direct-On-Line (DOL), Star-Delta, and Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) systems.
* Performed circuit breaker maintenance, ensuring safe isolation procedures and testing equipment integrity during plant shutdowns and commissioning.
* Worked with hydraulic and pneumatic systems on plant equipment, carrying out basic diagnostics, hose replacements, and actuator servicing.
* Contributed to the maintenance of radio communication systems, performing minor repairs and signal testing to support operational communication reliability.
* Participated in power system fault-finding exercises, assisting electricians in diagnosing voltage drops, phase failures, and earth faults within plant circuits.
* Collaborated in the installation of cable trays, cable routing, and cable jointing as part of plant expansion and maintenance projects.
* Supported testing and commissioning of new installations, performing insulation resistance tests, continuity checks, and system functionality verifications.
* Attended toolbox talks and risk assessments, actively promoting a safety-first culture and ensuring adherence to site safety regulations.
* Completed job cards, inspection reports, and maintenance records as part of plant documentation and compliance requirements.
* Assisted in the maintenance of weighing and online monitoring systems, ensuring continuous plant material tracking and process control.
* Worked under supervision to learn and apply principles of control engineering, fault diagnosis, and system integration in a live mining environment.

System Monitoring & POC Management

openings.title: Financial Crime Analyst EDD_X 10_2 YEARS FTC
openings.description:
To utilize advanced Anti-Money Laundering (AML) knowledge and investigative skills to perform comprehensive Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) reviews, analyses, and investigations on high-risk clients, entities, and transactions. The role aims to proactively identify and mitigate potential money laundering, terrorist financing, and reputational risks, ensuring full compliance with internal policies, regulatory obligations, and international best practices to safeguard the bank from financial crime exposure.

Key Responsibilities

The individual will be responsible for, but not limited to the following:

Enhanced Due Diligence and Investigations

  • Conduct comprehensive EDD reviews on high-risk clients, including politically exposed persons (PEPs), complex ownership structures, cross-border entities, and clients operating in high-risk jurisdictions.
  • Perform detailed analysis of the source of funds and source of wealth, transactional behaviour, and customer profiles to assess the legitimacy and consistency of activity.
  • Apply professional judgment and advanced analytical techniques to identify unusual patterns, red flags, or inconsistencies during the onboarding, review, or remediation process.
  • Utilize open-source intelligence adverse media screening, and database searches (e.g., World-Check, Dow Jones) to enrich client risk assessments.
  • Evaluate customer risk ratings and recommend appropriate risk mitigation measures or relationship management actions (e.g., enhanced monitoring, account restrictions, or exit).

Investigative Analysis and Reporting

  • Investigate and analyze suspicious activities or alerts generated by transaction monitoring systems or referrals from business units, providing objective findings and recommendations.
  • Prepare clear, concise, and well-documented EDD and investigation reports that summarize key facts, findings, and rationale for decisions made.
  • Support escalation and reporting processes, including drafting Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) or Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) when applicable.

Risk Management and Governance

  • Ensure adherence to AML/CTF legislation, internal policies, and regulatory standards governing customer due diligence and financial crime prevention.
  • Escalate potential financial crime risks to senior management and recommend appropriate remedial actions.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of EDD and investigative frameworks by identifying control gaps, process inefficiencies, and opportunities for automation or enhancement.
  • Support cross-functional collaboration with Compliance, Legal, Business, and Risk teams to ensure consistent application of EDD principles across the bank.

Performance and Quality Assurance

  • Deliver on contracted performance objectives and manage assigned work queues in line with agreed service level agreements (SLAs) and turnaround times.
  • Maintain high-quality standards in documentation, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and audit readiness of all EDD and investigation files.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Finance
  • Accounting
  • Law
  • Criminology
  • Business Administration
  • Economics

Key Competencies & Skills:

  • Analytical Thinking
  • Attention to Detail
  • Ethical Judgment and Integrity
  • Transaction Monitoring
  • KYC/CDD/EDD Procedures
  • Report Writing

openings.title: Filter Plant Superintendent
openings.description:
BASIC FUNCTION OF THE POSITION:

This role is required to provide commissioning supervision on the new tailings Filter Plant as well as operational oversight for the post commissioning phase. The Filter Plant Superintendent oversees the commissioning, operation and maintenance of the tailings Filter Plant and associated ancillaries, ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant tailings dewatering management aligned with metallurgical and pastefill requirements. This role integrates process engineering, maintenance coordination, legal compliance, and stakeholder engagement to optimize tailings filtration, water recovery, and filter cake deposition onto stockpiles for haulage to Zone 5.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Your key accountabilities include:

Overseeing commissioning as part of the owner’s team for the thickening and filtration of the tailings filter plant.
• Managing Technical Queries (TQs) and driving Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) throughout commissioning.
• Developing and implementing commissioning plans.
• Overseeing site testing and validation of equipment.
• Overseeing plant start-up, ramp-up and transitioning to steady state.
• Tracking and driving progress against the project schedule to meet key milestones.
• Coordination of interfaces with OEM’s, the project and operational management teams, to ensure technical alignment.
• Promoting and maintaining a strong safety culture on-site to support a safe work environment.
• Identifying anomalies and initiating corrective actions to prevent failures and maintain final product quality.
• Managing contractor services and performance for all filter plant related activities to uphold quality and safety.
• Planning and overseeing tailings filtration related projects, ensuring delivery within time, cost, and quality parameters.
• Initiating special projects based on operational assessments to drive improvements and innovation.
• Contributing to CAPEX and OPEX budgeting and championing cost-saving initiatives for facility optimization.
• Supporting optimal equipment utilization and enhancing plant efficiency through proactive operational oversight.
• Tracking the overall risk log for the commissioning and transitioning process to ensure requisite controls remain in place to contain identified risks.
• Document Control in terms of commissioning/operational process status.
• Monitoring and reporting KPIs—such as water balance, infrastructure availability, and plant efficiency—to ensure optimal performance and proactive risk management.
• Maintaining comprehensive records of spares, consumables, and maintenance activities to support accountability and operational readiness.
• Reviewing and validating operational data for accuracy and compliance, ensuring integrity in reporting and adherence to standards.
• Contributing to production reports and supporting incident documentation to maintain transparency and facilitate continuous improvement.
• Facilitating the training and development of tailings filter plant personnel to enhance operational competence and safety awareness.
• Ensuring staff comprehension and adherence to relevant acts, regulations, and company policies to maintain compliance and operational integrity.
• Overseeing commissioning contract delivery in terms of the SHEC file stipulations for the tailings Filter Plant.
• Enforcing the Fatal Risk safety protocol during the commissioning and operational phase of the tailings filtration plant.
• Enforcing both the Safety and Environmental management frameworks.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED FOR EFFECTIVE PERFORMANCE:

Degree in Metallurgical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering or related field.
• Must have experience in overseeing commissioning and operational ramp-up scope of the tailings filtration plant as part of the owner’s team.
• Demonstrated experience in Managing Technical Queries (TQs) and Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC).
• Must have at least 10 years exposure to commissioning/ operation/maintenance of horizontal membrane press filters, with 5 of those years at senior level.
• Full commissioning of a Metso Larox FFP 3512 unit with the following specifications:
o filtration area of 1153 m2,
o plate sizes 3500mm x 2500mm,
o up to 98 chambers.
o throughput of 374t (dry)/hr.
• Review of payment claims and managing variations.
• Tracking and driving progress against the commissioning schedule.
• Conduct daily reporting, progress monitoring, and escalate issues to MMG Management as required.

HOW TO APPLY:

Please send your CV and motivation only, to; Human
Resource Manager at: kcmrecruitment@mmg.com

NB: Write ONLY the title of the position you are applying for on the subject line.

A valid class B driver’s license and good driving record is a must for all positions.

Due to the high volume of applications received for our advertised positions, only shortlisted applications will be contacted.
To those applicants not shortlisted, we extend our appreciation for considering MMG/Khoemacau Copper Mining as a potential employer.

openings.title: Area Lead
openings.description:
BASIC FUNCTION OF THE POSITION:

The Area Lead will monitor, and control quality and adequacy of the design prepared within the functional discipline. This includes reviewing data for validity, directing optimization and technical studies, verifying design documents and specifications, and providing support and clarification in the discipline/area of operation. Guide and engage with the EPCM to ensure client facility and operational requirements are met. Support the Operational Readiness (OR) Manager and the Commissioning Manager driving the project to operational maturity.

 

MAJOR DUTIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Your key accountabilities include:

Supporting the scoping of services and the development of a strategic implementation plan for the responsible area.
• Serving as the primary point of contact for all stakeholders within the designated area, including project managers, engineers, contractors, and clients.
• Reviewing all quality assurance processes applied in the area of responsibility and ensuring that these are implemented both during the design and construction phases.
• Facilitating regular process meetings to discuss project status, challenges, and solutions.
• Assisting in compilation of monthly reporting to Senior Project Manager, Exco and the Board.

• Reviewing and approving engineering deliverables, construction plans and commissioning procedures.
• Addressing technical challenges and providing solutions to ensure the seamless integration of engineering, construction, and commissioning phases.
• Supporting the development and management of detailed project plans ensuring alignment with overall project timelines and objectives.
• Ensuring construction activities are executed safely, on time, and within budget.
• Collaborating with contractors and subcontractors to manage resources, materials, and equipment.

openings.title: Cost Controller
openings.description:
BASIC FUNCTION OF THE POSITION:

The purpose of this role is to ensure that the MMG-Khoemacau Expansion project is delivered on budget, perform cost control functions which include cost estimating and budgeting, cost control, cash out tracking and monitoring, cost forecasting and analysis, change management, cash call and reporting.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Your key accountabilities include:

Participating and assisting in developing detailed and accurate project budgets.
• Establishing the project cost baseline and obtaining approval and endorsement from the project management team.
• Implementing a cost control system to regularly (e.g., weekly/monthly) tracking and recording all actual project costs.
• Accurately comparing actual costs against budgets and forecasts.
• Analysing cost variances, investigating the reasons for deviations, and providing clear analysis to the project management team.
• Regularly updating the Estimate at Completion (EAC) based on project progress and trends, collaborating with all stakeholders.
• Forecasting potential future cost overrun risks and issuing early warnings.
• Preparing and submitting cost reports, dashboards, and presentations regularly, (e.g., weekly/monthly) to clearly communicate the project’s financial status to the project management team.
• Maintaining close communication with the project management team, finance, procurement, and engineers to ensure the accuracy and consistency of cost information.
• Assessing the cost impact of project change requests and assisting in adjusting budgets for changes.
• Ensuring all changes are formally approved and reflected in the updated budget pool.
• Participating in improving cost control processes, tools, and templates to enhance the efficiency of cost management across the project team.
• Being visible in the field, conducting frequent interactions with operations teams/contractors to understand work being done, and identifying opportunities to improve.
• Always demonstrating safe behaviour and complying with the site’s standards and procedures in SHEC.
• Promoting awareness of SHEC practices and imbedding a safety culture.
• Demonstrating effective performance in achieving agreed SHEC goals that support the department site and company standards.
• Reporting all SHEC incidents.
• Demonstrating leadership in SHEC through personal behaviours and conversations.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED FOR EFFECTIVE PERFORMANCE:

 

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering Management, Civil Engineering, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• Chinese and English language ability to work under multi-culture environment.
• PMP certificate or equivalent.
• At least 5 years of experience in project cost control within energy industrial projects, experience in Mining industry or Concentrator Project is preferable.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., pivot tables, VLOOKUP, advanced charts) for data analysis and modeling.
• Experience of using ECOSYS, SAP or similar software or platforms on project execution.
• Experience with cost control including project estimating, forecasting and cost management including reporting.
• Experience with cost control and best practice on capital power projects.
• In-depth understanding of project management and cost control principles, methods, and best practices (e.g., Earned Value Management – EVM).
• Experience with specialized project management/cost control software (e.g., Oracle Primavera P6, SAP, MS Project, Power BI).
• On site experience in the countries in Southern Africa is preferable.

Plan, develop and implement fit for purpose Health, Safety, and Environmental Management Systems that ensure that effective controls are in place.

openings.description:

The Logistics Lead will be responsible for the MMG-Khoemacau Expansion project logistics and transportation of equipment, materials and the management of customs clearance processes.

Managing and guiding the specific work of logistics specialists, formulating and revising the management system and work process of import and export declaration, storage and transportation, document preparation, insurance and other work processes of project materials, as well as supervising and inspecting the implementation of the system process.

openings.title: Ventillation Officer
openings.description:
BASIC FUNCTION OF THE POSITION:

The primary role of the Ventilation Officer is to ensure the effective design, implementation, and maintenance of ventilation systems to safeguard the health and safety of underground mine personnel in an underground mining operation.

Performing a variety of ventilation-related measurements and surveys, underground and on the surface.

• Collecting data on air quality, temperature, humidity, and gas levels within the mine.

openings.title: Construction Superintendent
openings.description:
BASIC FUNCTION OF THE POSITION:

The Construction Superintendent will oversee the day-to-day operations of construction projects related to roads, earthworks, and civil engineering. This role involves ensuring that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. The successful candidate will have a strong background in civil engineering and construction management, with a particular focus on roads and earthworks.

MAJOR DUTIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Key accountabilities include:

Supervising and coordinating all construction activities on-site, ensuring that projects are completed according to the project plan, specifications, and standards.
• Leading and managing a team of construction workers, subcontractors, and site personnel. Ensuring that all team members understand their roles and responsibilities and are working effectively towards project goals.
• Monitoring construction work to ensure compliance with design specifications, codes, and standards. Conducting regular inspections and assessments to ensure quality workmanship.
• Enforcing strict adherence to health and safety regulations on-site. Conducting safety meetings, risk assessments, and ensuring that all safety protocols are followed.
• Coordinating the use of materials, equipment, and labour to optimize efficiency and minimize costs. Monitoring inventory and order supplies as needed.
• Preparing and submitting daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports.
• Documenting and reporting any issues, delays, or changes to the project plan to senior management.
• Liaising with Project Managers, engineers, and clients to provide updates on project progress and address any concerns or requirements.
• Identifying and resolving any issues or conflicts that arise during the construction process. Implementing corrective actions as necessary to keep the project on track.
• Assisting in the preparation and management of project budgets. Monitoring expenses and ensuring that projects are completed within financial constraints.
• Providing technical guidance and support to the construction team, ensuring that all work is carried out according to best practices and engineering principles.

openings.title: Control and Instrumentation (C&I) Engineer
openings.description:
BASIC FUNCTION OF THE POSITION:

The Control and Instrumentation (C&I) Engineer will use their design, maintenance and operations experience to review and/or generate designs, provide technical input and guidance and undertake inspections to ensure works performed by consultants and contractors are in accordance with the scope of the project and to ensure the works are designed to MMG-Khoemacau Botswana and international standards and regulatory requirements.

The position holder will also use their experience in planning, executing, monitoring and coordinating the cost-effective maintenance activities for instrumentation field and control equipment and services to ensure optimal equipment availability and reliability is incorporated into the design and installation of the project works. Additionally, the incumbent will work in multidisciplinary teams to collaborate with professionals from other engineering disciplines to ensure seamless integration of control and instrumentation across all areas of the project.

MAJOR DUTIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Key accountabilities include:

Developing an understanding of the specific control and instrumentation requirements per project.
• Providing technical support for vendors, field electrical, control and instrumentation personnel, and engineering subcontractors as related to inquiries.
• Undertaking system and unit equipment analysis, engineering and design as required to support the project.
• Developing scopes of work and cost estimates for the project as required.
• Developing commissioning and operational readiness plans particularly with input to control and instrumentation systems and process control systems.
• Supervising the installation, commissioning and maintenance of all instrumentation and control systems.
• Using your knowledge, education and experience with motor and power protection systems to assist in delivery of the project.
• Maintaining project-specific requirements while applying general knowledge of mining and processing systems, equipment and project general specifications and standards.
• Communicating relevant project specific information with other departments.
• Providing technical interface with project representative(s).
• Establishing and maintaining effective relationships with all key stakeholders and business partners to ensure achievement of project objectives.
• Interpreting and ensuring compliance with project specifications and internal controls.
• Ensuring environmental impact falls within and complies with statutory requirements.
• Identifying and mitigating risks related to cost, schedule, technical performance, feasibility and logistics.
• Proactively reducing impacts associated with risks; ensuring design, installation, operation and maintenance of equipment is of high quality and standard.
• Managing a safe and healthy work environment where workers and contractors can deliver their outputs within a controlled risk environment.
• Developing and maintaining an electrical engineering schedule that provides timely delivery of material to fully support schedule.
• Communicating status updates to engineering management on a regular cadence.
• Relaying information regarding changes to scope of work for the project as they occur.
• Supporting weekly meetings with project team members and projects.
• Delegating and monitoring tasks given to engineering team members on regular cadence.
• Coaching, mentoring, and developing individual and team capability.
• Encouraging and leading a work culture of continuous improvement.
• Adhering to the company’s SHEC policy, procedure and Code of Conduct and acting as conduit to suppliers, and contractors.
• Applying and monitoring compliance with MMG-Khoemacau SHEC policies and procedures by subordinate staff, proposing remedial action and reporting all incidents and accidents, following established procedures.
• Adhering and enforcing all sanctioned SHEC and Operational Standards and Procedures.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED FOR EFFECTIVE PERFORMANCE:

 

Bachelor’s of Engineering (Electrical) – with specialisation in instrumentation and control.
• Qualifications in Project Management will be highly regarded.
• A minimum of 8 years post qualification experience in process control, with at least 5 years as C & I Foreman/Supervisor/Superintendent in a heavy mining process plant control and instrumentation maintenance environment.
• Experience with DCS and various plant PLC’s and drives.
• Construction experience in electrical and/or instrumentation and control installations.
• Thorough knowledge of MQW&M.
• Thorough knowledge of Control and Instrumentation installation systems.
• Process Control and instrumentation skills.
• Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) programming skills.
• Supervisory Control and Data acquisition (SCADA) Configuration skills particularly Citect SCADA.
• Network skills including Ethernet, Profinet/Profibus, Modbus TCP/IP.
• Motor automation and control including electronic motor protection.
• Electronic feeder and transformer unit protection.

HOW TO APPLY:

Please send your CV and motivation only, to; Human Resource Manager at: kcmrecruitment@mmg.com

NB: Write ONLY the title of the position you are applying for on the subject line.

A valid class B driver’s license and good driving record is a must for all positions.

Due to the high volume of applications received for our advertised positions, only shortlisted applications will be contacted.
To those applicants not shortlisted, we extend our appreciation for considering MMG/Khoemacau Copper Mining as a potential employer.

openings.title: Senior Investment Analyst (Fixed Income)
openings.description:
Role Summary

The role exists to support the Portfolio Manager in managing fixed-income investments within Bifm to achieve optimal returns and align portfolios with strategic objectives. This involves fixed-income and macro research, portfolio analytics, trading, and supporting the PM in fixed-income strategy formulation and execution, ensuring seamless integration of the strategy into the portfolio management process both within the department and with other departments in Bifm.

 

Role Responsibility

  • Support the portfolio manager in fixed income and macro research and management of Fixed Income portfolios, including money market funds, bond portfolios and asset-liability matching portfolios. Participate and contribute towards strategic initiatives and projects within the Fixed Income desk.
  • Conduct thorough research on fixed-income securities and markets, including sovereign, corporate, and other debt instruments.
  • Maintain regular interactions with relevant stakeholders to keep abreast of all market developments and identify opportunities and risks associated with them
  • Analyze macroeconomic indicators, market trends, and credit fundamentals to identify investment opportunities and risks.
  • Performing periodic portfolio analytics and making trade recommendations as and when necessary.
  • Preparing periodic portfolio reports and presenting at various platforms within the business as and when required.
  • Monitor portfolio allocations, performance, and risk metrics, ensuring alignment with client benchmarks and investment mandates.
  • Management of liquidity across all fixed-income portfolios, ensuring adequate levels of liquidity at all times through prudent, proactive management
  • Conduct valuation of unlisted debt instruments on a monthly basis through FinCad, with accuracy and timeliness in mind.
  • Identify investment opportunities by maintaining constant communication with market intermediaries (banks, counterparties, dealers/brokers etc.)
  • Negotiate instrument prices, prepare auction bids and seek best execution for both secondary and primary issuances.
  • Assist the Client Relations team with client queries in a manner that demonstrates knowledge of the market, key performance drivers, investment outlook and internal house views.
  • Assist the Portfolio Manager with all portfolio transitions (onboarding, offboarding, and any other transitions of fixed income mandates/portfolios.
  • Assist with the preparations of client presentations and attend report backs.

 

Qualifications & Role Specific Knowledge

  • Relevant degree in Finance, Economics or Investment Management Discipline
  • Minimum of 5 years post qualification in the financial services industry preferably in asset management and extensive knowledge of fixed income asset management and liquidity management.
  • Qualified Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) or working towards the qualification. Other relevant professional qualification (CA, ACCA, CIMA, CAIA) are an added advantage.

 

Competencies

  • Demonstrate sufficient knowledge and experience of the Fixed income market, ALM and liquidity management.
  • Show financial service industry experience including exposures to financial instruments.
  • Demonstrate extensive experience and knowledge of macro-economic factors including detailed analysis and interpretation.
  • Demonstrate ability to create reliable professional relationships with all relevant stakeholders.
  • Demonstrate presentation skills.
  • Be self motivated and able to use initiative.
  • Plan and be methodical and demonstrate an ability to work well under pressure.
  • Be self confident, diligent and highly analytical.

The Company offers an attractive remuneration package with benefits.
Note: Communication will be made to shortlisted candidates only

Closing Date:  01 December 2025

openings.title: General Secretary
openings.description:
Role Responsibilities

  • The General Secretary shall conduct the business of the Union in accordance with Constitution and its rules and shall carry out the instructions of the CEC/NGC and the NEC.
  • Supervise, and be responsible for conducting all correspondence and keeping all books, minutes, records, documents and papers belonging to the Union in a such a form and manner as the NEC may direct.
  • Formulation and implementation of the Union’s Strategic plan.
  • Developing and reviewing organisational policies, including a business continuity plan, policies and procedures.
  • To develop management and organisational structures and processes that enable union to deliver its strategic aims and objectives.
  • Ensures compliance to OSH protocols and performance reviews of staff.
  • Ensuring membership representation across all statutory established dispute resolution and case management mechanisms.
  • Facilitate the functions of collective bargaining and organizing in respect of national negotiations with employers and other agencies as directed by NEC.
  • Coordinate robust membership recruitment strategies and organising of union structures and members activism.
  • Oversee diagnostic membership training needs and priorities across union structures.
  • Undertake review of union education, training and capacity building strategies in order to align with existing capacity needs and demands across union structures.
  • To proactively coordinate harmonious union relations with internal and external sister unions, partners and key stakeholders.
  • Coordinate the union lobby and advocacy strategies as directed by the union President and the NEC.
  • Ensure that the union operates within budget and that union activities and project plans are implemented financial prudently and aligned to cost controls.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources Management, Public Administration, Business Administration, Political Science, Industrial Psychology, International Relations, Law or Equivalent.

Experience

  • Membership to a professional leadership and corporate bodies body will be an added advantage.

Knowledge & Skills required

  • Excellent leadership skills, along with honesty, integrity and trustworthiness.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including negotiation, persuasion and representation, as well as the preparation and presentation of reports and submissions on complex industrial, legal and political issues.
  • The ability to act as an advocate for the Union in influencing key figures in government, public sector, employers and the wider labour movement at national and international level.
  • Sound strategic planning skills, together with the ability to identify and deliver organisational objectives.
  • High degree of personal organisation, planning and time management, able and willing to work odd hours.
  • Political savvy in current Trade Union context and environment.
  • The ability to react promptly and responsibly to rapidly changing situations, often in a stressful environment.
  • Conversant with labour laws of Botswana.
  • Computer literacy.

  • Ensure that internal and external controls and procedures are in place, understood and complied with including Financial Regulations, Health & Safety Regulations/Legislation and good employment policies.
  • Monitor and control interaction between Departments to ensure that the union financial expenditure and resources are utilized prudently.
  • Ensure a robust membership representation across cadres.
  • Act as liaison officer to ensure a clear and efficient response to complaints from members and ensure reciprocal and timely feedback.
  • Designing membership recruitment strategies and frameworks and ensure subsequent implementation, monitoring and evaluation.
  • Continuous development of membership value propositions to ensure competitiveness of the union.

Qualifications

  • Diploma in Human Resources Management, Public Administration, Business Administration, Political Science, Industrial Psychology, International Relations, Law or Equivalent.

Experience

  • Membership to a professional leadership and corporate bodies body will be an added advantage.

Knowledge & Skills required

  • Excellent leadership skills, along with honesty, integrity and trustworthiness.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including negotiation, persuasion and representation, as well as the preparation and presentation of reports and submissions on complex industrial, legal and political issues.
  • The ability to act as an advocate for the Union in influencing key figures in government, public sector, employers and the wider labour movement at national and international level.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer the incumbent will be responsible for the coordination, monitoring and evaluation of the BNSC Strategy, annual planning, organisational performance; the management of the central project data base; manage the execution of the BNSC Strategy and reporting to the Board on quarterly basis.

Key tasks & responsibilities
Lead the coordination, monitoring and evaluation of the BNSC Strategy process and content, and annual planning and performance scorecard.
Coordinate the cascading of the corporate strategy to Departments and National Sport Associations (NSAs).
Set-up and manage the administration of the central project management database to ensure safe custody of all BNSC project reports.
Leads the research process from proposal to presentation of findings to enhance the strategic and operational effectiveness of the BNSC; to keep up to date with global best practice in sport development and administration.
Provide technical advice and assistance to various project and programme officers in the monitoring and evaluation of their projects/programs; senior management regarding best practice regarding sport development and administration.
Budgeting, reporting, monitoring, and evaluation of projects and the performance scorecard of the Annual Plan on a quarterly and annual basis to support the BNSC strategy.
Qualifications & Experience
A Bachelor’s Degree in Strategy Management, Monitoring & Evaluation or equivalent.
Certification or professional qualifications in Balanced Scorecard.
Master’s Degree as an added advantage.
A minimum of 8 years’ experience in a Strategy Management environment, of which 3 should be at a supervisory level.
Competencies
Problem solving skills
Strong Leadership skills
Critical Thinking and Innovation
Good interpersonal skills
Assertiveness and decisiveness
Facilitation Skills
Innovative

Benefits and Remuneration
The Botswana National Sport Commission offers a competitive salary and range of benefits commensurate with an organization of its size.

openings.title: Accountant
openings.description:
About the role

The Accountant will play a central role in maintaining financial integrity, ensuring compliance with Botswana’s accounting standards, and providing accurate financial insights for executive decision-making. The position requires strong analytical ability, hands-on accounting experience, and a deep understanding of the retail industry’s financial processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare, interpret, and present complex financial data for senior leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Deliver accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
  • Identify and resolve financial discrepancies through detailed analytical reviews.
  • Manage statutory tax obligations including Withholding Tax, VAT, PAYE, and Income Tax, ensuring compliance with BURS regulations.
  • Oversee payroll management, ensuring accuracy and compliance with Botswana labour and tax laws.
  • Lead and support internal and external audits, while ensuring compliance with evolving financial regulations.
  • Utilize SAP or similar ERP systems to improve financial processes and reporting efficiency.
  • Requirements
  • BICA registration (mandatory).
  • Minimum of 5+ years’ work experience, preferably in the retail sector.
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field. Additional relevant accounting qualifications will be considered.
  • Progress toward or completion of ACCA is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience handling tax processes (Withholding Tax, VAT, PAYE, Income Tax).
  • Proficiency in SAP or similar accounting software and ERP systems.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Previous experience in audits and compliance within Botswana’s financial regulations.
  • What We Offer
  • Competitive remuneration package.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.
  • A collaborative, high-performance work environment committed to excellence and compliance.
  • How to Apply

Application Deadline: 5 December 2025

Send your CV to: botswanahradmin@pnp.co.za

openings.title: Investment Officer
openings.description:
Reporting to the Senior Investment Officer, your role will be to assist in business development and to initiate deal structuring, execution, and portfolio management processes in accordance with the approved investment strategies, policies and procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Responsibilities will incorporate providing pertinent information required for the development and implementation of BDC’s investment and divestment strategy, enterprise and sector development strategy and the department’s business development plans.
  • You will also perform deal structuring and execution processes for assigned deals and draft documents for the review and inputs of Senior Investment Officers or Investment Principals in all stages of the deal origination process.
  • You will also be responsible for actively maintaining the assigned portfolio of companies in accordance with set merits, as well as update monitoring parameters and reports.
  • Collate all required information for investment application requiring evaluation and due diligence on assist the structuring and execution unit with due diligence, financial analysis, and modelling, drafting of investment papers, co-ordination of internal approval processes, and finalization of legal documentation in transaction processes.
  • Assist with maintenance monitoring activities including preparation of reports and presentations, client visits and recommendations for improvement of investment portfolios.
  • Additionally, you will conduct basic due diligence on companies and industries by researching, reading financial statements, and monitoring news using specialist media sources and assess sector implications or impact on portfolio of companies and matter data and collating information for senior investment staff.
  • Provide professional and administrative support to the investment team including setting up of meetings with clients, drafting meeting agendas, drafting minutes of meetings, preparing reports, collating information, filing of documents and obtaining of signatures/signoffs etc.
  • Professionally, you will assist in the management of close working relationships with clients, through regular business calls and client visits in alignment with the client engagement strategy of BDC.
  • Qualifications
  • The candidates should have a Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Commerce, or related discipline from a reputable institution, and discipline from a reputable institution and / or a professional finance or accounting qualification from a recognised institution as well as membership and in good standing with e.g. CFA, ACCA or CIS.
  • You should have a minimum of three (3) years analyst experience in financial services/ investment environment with a focus on accounting, corporate finance advisory, Investment banking, financial audit, lending and investment transaction experience.
  • How to Apply

Candidates who meet the above criteria should submit their applications to recruitment@bdc.bw

BDC offers a commensurate package with attractive benefits.

openings.title: Chief Geologist
openings.description:
BASIC FUNCTION OF THE POSITION:
The Chief Geologist will be responsible for the establishment of a systematic and integrated approach to applying modern methods in the management of geological processes on site in support of a productive mechanized mining environment. You will establish grade control drilling and modelling processes, operational mine geology procedures, systems and processes and lead the Geology department in a collaborative and efficient manner in support of the mining operations.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Your key accountabilities include:

  • Developing an efficient and suitable method for Grade Control drilling and modelling of the orebody to ensure timely delivery of quality information to the Mining teams
  • Formulating of departmental strategy and measuring in line with the Company plan
  • Developing of an efficient and suitable method for Grade Control drilling and modelling of the orebody to ensure timely delivery of quality information to the Mining teams
  • Designing and developing of underground diamond drilling programmes as required for exploration, resource conversion to reserve and grade control drilling
  • Overseeing the effective management of diamond drilling processes to ensure safe, efficient and productive work from drilling to core management through to updating of information to the geological database
  • Ensuring the introduction of relevant and appropriate systems for efficient mine mapping and capturing of mine data through to geological and mine design software
  • Ensuring the management of the day-to-day function of the Geology department, in a collaborative manner with Mining Operations and Technical teams
  • Driving the formulation of the annual mine geology capital and operating budgets as well as the management of departmental costs in line with approved budgets.
  • Managing the development of systems for reporting and reconciliation as needed to effectively manage the performance of the orebody and geological models in line with site and company requirements.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED FOR EFFECTIVE PERFORMANCE:

  • BSc (Hons) Geology Degree
  • Qualified for QP sign off will be advantageous;
  • 15 years post qualification experience, with a minimum of 10 years in an underground hard rock mechanised mining environment (predominantly base metals, or relevant gold experience);
  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience as a Senior Geologist in a production environment.
  • Experience of industry processes, procedures, policies and values as relates to geology;
  • Understanding of Botswana Mines, Quarries, Works & Machinery Act and the various applicable licenses;
  • Demonstrated strength in structural geology, mine operational geology, geological database and orebody modelling, and geology department management;
  • Formal professional or technical registration with an internationally recognised Geological Body;
  • Experience with a suite of Geological software required for the mine

openings.title: Standards Officer
openings.description:
BASIC FUNCTION OF THE POSITION:
The Standards Officer will be responsible for coordinating and controlling the standards function by ensuring that materials and services procured for the company are of the appropriate quality, specification, and safety for their intended use, and are available to the operating sections of the firm in good condition when required.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Your key accountabilities include:

  • Ensuring coding and classification of existing and new stock items within the AMCAT system.
  • Ensuring that inventory database is regularly updated with current information when stock items are superseded.
  • Ensuring that stock applications for new stock items are processed immediately when received.
  • Checking all new stock and specified equipment before it is accepted for binning at receiving section, thus controlling the quality of stock being received.
  • Rejecting items that do not conform to specifications.
  • Investigating all quality complaints and physically verifies such and offers corrective and preventative action.
  • Verifying the details of the request for testing material, approves, and submits to the standards committee for final processing.
  • Ensuring records for tested materials are maintained and made available all the time.
  • Participating in the company supplier assessments.
  • Investigating and identifies slow, nonmoving materials/spares to recommend redundancies and obsolete items with the view to rationalize, standardize, write off and or sometimes dispose of off as appropriate e.g., contact other users, sell back to suppliers, sell as scrap.
  • Evaluating stock item returns and decides their approval based on stock at hand quantities.
  • Ensuring that all chemicals have material safety data sheets (16 points) before they could be procured to comply with Khoemacau Safety & Health and Environmental & Community policies.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED FOR EFFECTIVE PERFORMANCE:

  • CIPS Level 4/ NCC/ Diploma in Mechanical/Electrical/Instrumentation
  • 3 years’ experience in a similar role preferably in a mining/construction industry
  • Quality Assurance and standards courses (SABS/BOBS/ISO)
  • Experience with working in an ERP environment.

openings.title: RO Plant Technician
openings.description:
BASIC FUNCTION OF THE POSITION:
The RO Plant Technician will be responsible for the effective operation, maintenance, and reliability of the Reverse Osmosis (RO) water treatment plant. The role ensures optimal plant availability, quality water production, and compliance with preventive and predictive maintenance schedules. This includes performing maintenance, membrane and media replacement, PPMs, and troubleshooting to support safe and efficient plant operation.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Your key accountabilities include:

  • Performing routine and corrective maintenance on all RO plant equipment, including pumps, valves, filters, dosing systems, and instrumentation.
  • Conducting membrane and Maddox (media) replacement, and PPM checks per manufacturer and site standards.
  • Executing scheduled maintenance plans to ensure minimal downtime and maximum availability of the RO system.
  • Troubleshooting and resolving plant performance issues to restore optimal efficiency.
  • Maintaining and calibrating instrumentation and control systems (flow, pressure, conductivity, pH monitoring).
  • Ensuring correct chemical dosing and safe handling of water treatment chemicals.
  • Maintaining accurate maintenance and performance records, including daily logs and reports.
  • Coordinating with the Maintenance Engineer for planning and execution of major maintenance tasks.
  • Promoting and maintaining a strong safety culture and compliance with all SHEC standards.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED FOR EFFECTIVE PERFORMANCE:

  • Trade Certificate or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, or Control & Instrumentation Engineering.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience working on industrial RO plants.
  • Experience with seawater RO (SWRO) systems is an advantage.
  • Additional training in water treatment operations will be an advantage.

openings.title: Maintenance Planner
openings.description:
BASIC FUNCTION OF THE POSITION:
The Maintenance Planner will be responsible for the maintenance management of fixed plant mechanical and electrical equipment in ensuring optimal plant availability and reliability, to achieve production targets.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Your key accountabilities include:

  • Conducting plant inspections, identifying defects, issuing and tracking work orders and reporting to responsible Engineers.
  • Maintaining accurate asset registers and technical documentation for all fixed plant equipment.
  • Developing and updating maintenance strategies, schedules and condition monitoring programmes in line with OEM requirements and equipment utilisation.
  • Planning work effectively by creating detailed job packages (scope, resources, standards, permits, risks, constraints and sequencing).
  • Managing and optimising the CMMS, including maintenance codes, job plans, job cards and job history.
  • Identifying and escalating all critical issues that threaten the successful planning of work for completion by the required date
  • Determining if planned costs in terms of labour, material, equipment, tools, contract services and any other costs on the work order are within the set cost limit
  • Ensuring compliance with legislation, standards, safe work procedures and risk controls in all planned work.
  • Prioritising work and coordinating planned maintenance and shutdowns, including resources, timelines and post-shutdown reviews.
  • Monitoring maintenance performance (e.g. schedule compliance, MTBF, MTTR, availability, OEE) and using reports to drive decisions.
  • Supporting budget development, monitoring costs against limits, and implementing cost-saving initiatives.
  • Driving continuous improvement, innovation and strong Safety, Health and Environmental performance across the section.
  • Generating various reports relating to asset maintenance, availability, utilisation, PPM activities and submitting to Engineers and Foremen.
  • Timely compiling and submitting maintenance reports.
  • Accurately maintaining the assets register.
  • Maintaining expenditure control and accounting.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED FOR EFFECTIVE PERFORMANCE:

  • National Craft Certificate in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering Or Diploma in Electrical /
  • Mechanical Engineering Or equivalent qualification
  • A minimum of 8 years post qualification in a Mechanical or Electrical Engineering field, with at least
  • 5 years in a mining environment doing fixed plant maintenance, at least 2 years of which must be in a supervisory position or a minimum of 5 years post qualification experience in a
  • Mining environment as a fixed plant Maintenance Planner.
  • Computer skills a prerequisite; MS Office, MS Project, PRONTO ERP, MS Excel
  • Computer based maintenance management system expertise

openings.title: HME Maintenance Specialist
openings.description:
BASIC FUNCTION OF THE POSITION:
The HME Maintenance Specialist will be responsible for technical expertise in the maintenance and reliability of light vehicles, heavy mining equipment, infrastructure and related services in the department. The role ensures safe, compliant and cost-effective maintenance practices, supporting continuous mining operations through effective maintenance management, equipment performance monitoring and adherence to legal and company standards.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Your key accountabilities include:

  • Enforcing and promoting site SSHE standards, legal compliance and safe work procedures.
  • Leading and commissioning of new light vehicles and heavy machines.
  • Carrying out audits of already approved equipment for compliance with the ISO standard, contractual agreement or specifications and MQWMA regulations to maintain set standards.
  • Ensuring compliance with statutory inspections, tests and approvals, Quarterly inspections of (Pressure vessels, rigging equipment, overhead cranes, LV lifting hoists, etc.) and serviced in accordance with manufacturers’ specifications
  • Reviewing mining contracts, standards, procedures and ensuring conformance to Principal requirements and best industry practices.
  • Developing and implementing QA and inspection procedures for equipment.
  • Managing and optimising maintenance plans and work management systems.
  • Analysing equipment performance and maintenance data to improve reliability.
  • Leading failure investigations and implementing corrective and preventative actions.
  • Planning and supporting Reliability Centred Maintenance (RCM) activities.
  • Managing and optimising critical and strategic spares inventory.
  • Providing high-level technical support and mentoring to maintenance teams.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED FOR EFFECTIVE PERFORMANCE:

  • National Craft Certificate or equivalent in Diesel Mechanics, Heavy Plant Mechanics, Millwright or related discipline.
  • A minimum of 8 years post-qualification experience, with at least 5 years in a mining environment doing HME plant maintenance, at least 3 years of which must be in a supervisory position.
  • Demonstrated diagnostic and troubleshooting skills as well as post-failure analysis on equipment such as Sandvik, Volvo and Normet Equipment.

openings.title: Control and Instrumentation Technician
openings.description:
BASIC FUNCTION OF THE POSITION:
The Control and Instrumentation Technician will be responsible for routine and advanced maintenance, troubleshooting and optimisation of instrumentation, control and automation systems. The role ensures accurate measurement, reliable process control and high plant availability by supporting PLC, SCADA, communication and field instrumentation systems. It involves performing planned and corrective maintenance work, resolving control system issues and maintaining compliance with engineering, safety and operational standards across all work areas.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Your key accountabilities include:

  • Performing maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimisation of field instrumentation, PLC, SCADA, communication systems, and related control equipment.
  • Diagnosing control system faults and troubleshooting plant performance anomalies using PLC/SCADA systems and historian data.
  • Conducting system backups, software updates, patching, and hardware/software compatibility checks on control systems.
  • Ensuring high-quality programming and configuration of Siemens PLCs and Citect SCADA systems.
  • Assisting in programming and troubleshooting of VSDs and fibre optic mine communication networks.
  • Supporting the development and executing preventative maintenance strategies for digital control systems.
  • Establishing and applying standards for system upgrades, testing, and maintenance in line with engineering and safety protocols in line with engineering and safety protocols.
  • Supporting E&I maintenance teams and coordinating SCADA/PLC software requirements.
  • Overseeing the work of contractors on the MMG Khoemacau control system, ensuring compliance with Khoemacau standards and procedures for undertaking specific work.

  • National Diploma in Control and Instrumentation/ Electrical/ Industrial Automation and Control Systems or a related field
  • At least 5 years of experience working as a Control Systems or Instrumentation Technician in a continuous plant operation environment
  • Proven experience with Profinet, Profibus network, Siemens PLC’s, Pi Historian, Citect SCADA 2018 R2, and AutoCAD

openings.title: Senior Mine Planning Engineer
openings.description:

The Senior Mine Planning Engineer will be responsible for providing strategic direction of the Company to maximise returns from its available ore resources producing assets while advancing pre-development projects that offer potential to sustain and grow the business in the long term.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Your key accountabilities include:

  • Translating broadly stated company objectives into detailed plans and schedules
  • Identifying long-term mining opportunities and developing strategies for their realization.
  • Ensuring that the medium-term development plan is compatible with the long-term plan and strategy
  • Coordinating the mine design and scheduling process through liaising and consultation with production managers.
  • Formulating departmental strategy and measures in line with the company plan
  • Establishing and maintaining a mine planning system using suitable software, to integrate geological resource models, geotechnical models, survey data, optimized designs, and productivity trends to accurately and timeously plan mining sequences and development phases to meet required production targets
  • Providing accurate designs and plans to ensure the mine can meet current and future production requirements
  • Overseeing operations to ensure adherence to short, medium, and long-term plans
  • Coordinating and reviewing the design of sub-level open stoping blocks and extraction and backfilling sequences
  • Coordinating and reviewing the design of mine development and services to support extraction and ensuring that technical and planning information is timeously made available to support mining production.

  • Experience in various underground mechanized mining methods is essential with at least 5 years’ experience with sub level open stoping methods.

BASIC FUNCTION OF THE POSITION:
The Mine Production Geologist will be responsible for supporting the mine operations, to collect, interpret and report on production geology issues, including logging / sampling core, wireframing, modelling, grade/tonnage estimations and reconciliations in alignment with the organization’s long-term objectives.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensuring that all core is logged and sampled within the production timelines.
  • Ensuring that all underground excavations are inspected during mining at regular intervals and that suitable control is maintained.
  • Monitoring material movements accurately through the mine to the mill and take an proactive approach towards minimising dilution and maximising ore recovery.
  • Ensuring underground excavations are geologically mapped and data communicated in a standard set by the Senior Production Geologist.
  • Proactively participating in geology interpretation including fault, structure, orebody and other geological features and ensure wireframing is completed accurately.
  • Providing assistance to the Senior Production Geologist in the management of diamond drill programs, including design, documentation, and coordination of programs and sites, and assistance with contractor management.
  • Participating in reporting and communication for the mine geology team, including ensuring the delivery of clear and concise handover documents in the event of absences from work.
  • Ensuring that data is collected accurately and that the data is entered into the database in a timely manner.
  • Managing ROM pad stocks and routinely reconcile results with mine and mill.
  • Assisting the Senior Production Geologist with estimating tonnes / grade, updating grade control model and reconciliation monitoring.
  • Communicating with other site technical, operational, support and managerial teams.
  • Establishing and maintaining effective communication with all drill contractors to ensure production objectives are met.
  • Implementing and adhering to systems, processes and procedures to ensure quality management.
  • Ensuring that geological activities are conducted within budget and the cost control framework.
  • Complying with data collection standards in respect to both the JORC code and NI-43-101 requirements.
  • Assisting with contributions for daily, weekly and monthly reporting on geological activities.
  • Ensuring that plans / sections are generated and kept up to date for the current grade control drilling.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED FOR EFFECTIVE PERFORMANCE:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Geology from a recognized tertiary institution.
  • Minimum 2 year’s post graduate geological experience in an underground hard rock environment.
  • Proficient in the use of mine software packages (Datamine and Leapfrog preferred)
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft software including Word, Excel, Access and PowerPoint

APPLICATION DETAILS

Please send your CV and motivation only to; Human Resources Manager at: kcmrecruitment@mmg.com

NB: Write ONLY the title of the position you are applying for on the subject line.

A valid class B driver’s license and good driving record is a must for all positions.

Due to the high volume of applications received for our advertised positions, only shortlisted applications will be contacted. To those applicants not shortlisted, we extend our appreciation for considering MMG/Khoemacau Copper Mining as a potential employer.

openings.description:
Job Purpose:
Reporting directly to the Board (and liaising with the Ministry of Communication and Innovation), the CEO provides overall visionary stewardship of BITRI – shaping strategy, driving organisational transformation, strengthening governance, and ensuring that research, innovation and technology outputs deliver measurable national impact. The CEO oversees executive management, human capital development, commercialisation initiatives, financial sustainability, stakeholder relations and performance delivery across the Institute.
The Job
The position will, inter alia, be responsible for the following:

  • Providing strategic and operational leadership to realise BITRI’s mandate, vision, and strategic goals.
  • Embedding a high-performance, values-driven culture aligned to corporate governance best practice.
  • Leading and overseeing research, innovation, technology development and technology transfer to ensure R&D outputs align with national priorities and are commercialised effectively.
  • Ensuring prudent resource management and driving financial sustainability through revenue generation, donor funding, and efficient use of human, financial and technological resources.
  • Developing, promoting and implementing BITRI’s commercialisation strategy.
  • Building and sustaining strategic partnerships with Government, industry, academia, donors, international research organisations and networks.
  • Strengthening stakeholder relations and reporting to the Board, Ministry and other key stakeholders on institutional performance, impact and R&D outcomes.
  • Leading organisational modernisation, digitalisation, cultural change and business transformation.
  • Providing high-quality support to the Board, including secretariat oversight, implementation of Board decisions, and provision of timely technical advice.
  • Managing and developing BITRI’s human capital; coaching senior executives; promoting cross-functional integration and multidisciplinary collaboration.
    Minimum Requirements

The Person
The right candidate will possess the following:

  • A PhD in Science, Engineering, Technology, Innovation, OR a Master’s Degree in Business Management or related field.
  • PhD holders: Minimum 7 years’ post-qualification experience, including at least 2 years in an executive leadership role.
  • Master’s Degree holders: Minimum 10 years’ post-qualification experience, including at least 5 years in an executive leadership role.
  • A proven track record of developing, leading and delivering transformative organisational strategies resulting in measurable growth and renewal.
  • Demonstrated experience in digitalisation, driving technology-enabled transformation and enhancing operational efficiency.
  • Proven ability to mobilise financial resources, attract donor funding, and build business or investment partnerships to support organisational sustainability.
  • Experience in technology transfer, commercialisation, intellectual property management and strategic partnerships across industry, academia and international collaborators.

To apply in confidence, please visit www.peopleconnections.co.bw. Applicants should submit a Cover Letter, Detailed Curriculum Vitae, and Academic Certificates. Application documents should be in .pdf format and merged.

Closing Date:  9 December 2025                Location: Gaborone, Botswana

For enquiries: Contact 3975917 / 3915503

openings.description:
OKAVANGO RESEARCH INSTITUTE (MAUN)

VACANCY NO: IRC 2915

Applications are invited for the position of Research Fellow in Environmental Analytical Chemistry at the Okavango Research Institute (ORI). The Institute is based in Maun, in north-western Botswana,     specializes in natural resources management, sustainable natural resource use and conservation in the iconic Okavango Delta and the adjacent dry area. Additional information on ORI including its Strategic Plan can be found on www.ori.ub.bw.

Duties:

 The successful candidate will be required to (i) design and  conduct environmental analytical chemistry research in and around the Okavango Delta ecosystem;  (ii) develop and perform chemical analyses on environmental samples (e.g., surface and ground water, soil, sediment, plant and animal tissues) to detect nutrients, metals, organic contaminants, pesticides, and other chemical parameters; (iii) advise and train laboratory staff and researchers on the use of advanced instrumentation in the ORI environmental laboratory; (iv) work in collaboration with hydro geochemists, surface and groundwater  hydrologists, ecologists, biogeochemists, and wetland scientists on multidisciplinary research initiatives in addition to developing their own research in line with the Institute’s research programmes; (v) conduct research in the Cubango-Okavango River with emphasis on the Delta and the rest of Botswana and (vi) assist in the development and validation of methods of chemical analyses, helping to ensure analytical consistency and accuracy in the Environmental Laboratory; (vii) interpret and report findings relevant to the environmental and ecosystem health of the Okavango Delta; (viii) prepare manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals and present findings at national and international conferences; (x) supervise and mentor undergraduate and postgraduate students and assist in developing laboratory training modules and safety protocols

Teaching jobs Botswana

Requirements:

 Applicants should possess: (i) a PhD in Analytical Chemistry, Environmental Chemistry or related fields in Chemistry (ii) show evidence of engagement in research (i.e., proof of submitted manuscripts and/ or published journal articles, book chapters, peer reviewed conference proceedings, etc. in reputable outlets); (iii) successful candidates should have experience with automated analysis or monitoring of major ions in water and/or biological material, experience in Quality Control, Statistics and computerised data analyses; (iv) Experience in the use of the following listed instruments such as, HPLC, GC, GC/MS elemental analyser, ICP, ion chromatograph and AAS is an added advantage. The following will also be considered as added advantages: (a) university teaching experience or equivalent, (b) a publication record (journal articles, book chapters, peer reviewed conference proceedings, etc; (c) evidence of governance and social engagement at departmental/faculty/university level (e.g., member/ secretary of a committee/task group/board, participation in departmental/faculty administration and committees, departmental/faculty representative to other bodies, etc.).

openings.title: Credit Analyst
openings.description:
Credit Analyst

Requisition Number:  46129

Key Responsibilities

Lead credit reviews, analyse and monitor client credit risk, to ensure creditworthiness.

  • Provide insightful, succinct and timely client portfolio credit analysis.
  • Accountable for spreading financials, proposing credit grades aligned to scorecards, documenting client risk and mitigants, and monitoring for credit-material events.
  • Partner with Banking, Coverage and Risk teams to develop and execute credit analysis, credit origination and monitoring relevant matters.
  • Deliver client fraud risk assessments to defined standards, documenting residual risks and mitigants.
  • Credit intelligence to identify business opportunities with an acceptable risk profile by supporting Relationship Managers, FI Bankers and Product teams with product solutioning and recommendations.
  • Provide credit analysis with consideration for market dynamics and client industry, including: 
        Industry risks and client competitive positioning within the industry.
        Client funding strategy, financial policies, treasury activities, including hedging, and cash management.
        Analyse client cash flow and liquidity with ratio analysis and/or stress testing balance sheet strength, cash flow and profitability vulnerability.
        Reputational risk profile, including climate and sustainability risks
  • Skills and Experience
  • Risk management lifecycle.
  • Financial forecasting and modelling.
  • Financial and quantitative skills.
  • Client due diligence.
  • Using client behaviours and preferences to evolve products and services.
  • Product knowledge for Markets, Transaction Banking and Corporate Finance.
  • Knowledge of the financial services' regulatory environment.
  • Data analysis and visualisation.
  • Ability to work under pressure, in a dynamic environment.
  • Degree in Finance or a Credit-related field
  • Chartered accountant or CFA qualification
  • About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviour. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together we:

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

openings.title: Head, Strategy & Risk
openings.description:
HEAD, STRATEGY & RISK: VACANCY CIRCULAR NO.1 OF 2026

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, the successful candidate will lead the development of the Authority’s strategic agenda, in line with the entity’s mandate, and will be in charge of driving business risk management.

In particular, the ideal candidate will be tasked with ensuring the establishment and rollout of strategic projects in line with the Authority’s strategic agenda. He/she will ensure effective project risk management, and a culture of continuous performance improvement across the entire organization.

KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

  1. Leads the development and ensures of the Authority’s overall corporate strategy aligned to the goals and objectives of Botswana’s Energy policy.
  2. Leads the development and review of the business plans to ensure effective delivery and execution of the Authority’s strategic objectives.
  3. Develops and reviews policies and procedures for specific area of responsibility.
  4. Conducts and ensures implementation of business plans and annual budgets.
  5. Initiates, develops, and recommends the adoption of Divisional initiatives and programs enterprise-wide.
  6. Spearheads the development and monitoring of the overall budget and ensures compliance with financial procedures and legislation.
  7. Establishes and implements performance management measures and frameworks within the Authority to ascertain relevance of its operations to the sector performance. Leads the implementation of enterprise wide risk management and driving business and strategic projects/initiatives.
  8. Develops and ensures the implementation of a risk management framework to align with international standards and best practice. Provides guidance on the measurement and evaluation of project performance.
  9. Develops and ensures the implementation of Strategy & Risk Division scorecard and frameworks of performance, in line with the goals and objectives of the Authority’s strategic agenda.
  10. Initiates, develops and recommends the adoption of Strategy & Risk Department strategies and initiatives to meet the Business and Industry needs.
  11. Coordinates the planning, design, development, maintenance, quality assurance, information security as well as ensuring effective management of both the technical and infrastructure components in a manner that ensures availability of required applications and infrastructure.
  12. Manages adherence to well as prevention and resolution of fraud.
  13. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
  • Degree in Engineering, Science, Commerce, Business Management or Social Sciences and any other business related fields at a minimum of Master’s Degree level will be an added advantage.
  • A minimum of 8 years’ experience in an energy related role, including 5 years at a Management level (Director or equivalent)
  • Professional Certification/s in fields such as Balanced Scorecard Certification; Six Sigma
  • Risk Management Certification
  • Chartered Institute of Directors Certification
  • Professional Membership(s) would be an added advantage.
  • REQUIRED COMPETENCIES
  • Strategic Thinking and Planning
  • Deciding and Initiating Action
  • Problem Solving
  • Financial Analysis
  • Planning and Organizing
  • Planning & Execution
  • Presenting and Communicating
  • Delivering Results and Meeting Customer Expectations
  • Interpersonal (AVI)
  • Innovation, Creativity & Originality
  • Business Process Design and engineering
  • Project Management
  • Teamwork and Partnering
  • APPLICATION PROCESS

Interested candidates must submit the Vacancy Circular Application Form together with:

Detailed latest Curriculum Vitae

  • Certified copy of Relevant Diploma / Degree Card (Omang)
  • Names and contacts details of three (3) traceable referees
  • Portfolio of two (2) recent work-related referees.
