JOB PURPOSE

Reporting to the Director Corporate Services, the successful candidate will be responsible for planning, developing, and implementing effective communication and public relations campaigns to protect and enhance its reputation. The role ensures consistent, clear and strategic messaging across all platforms while strengthening BERA’s relationship with the public and other key stakeholders. This position supports organizational goals by promoting brand awareness, enhancing public perception, and fostering stakeholder engagement and operational trust, to improve BERA’s public profile.

KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

  1. Leads, develops, and implements communication and PR policies, procedures, and guidelines to ensure compliance with the Authority’s brand standards and guidelines.
  2. Oversees and manages events with press and public associations, according to the communication and PR strategy, to ensure that the Authority’s public reputation is not affected.
  3. Oversees the activities of subcontractors and suppliers in order to deliver successful public relations campaigns.
  4. Develops, reviews, and issues press releases and briefs the media with the purpose of staying in line with BERA’s approved public image.
  5. Plans and develops public relations and communication campaigns to achieve public relations and communications goals.
  6. Works with writers, bloggers, and incorporates copy edits into meaningful language by reviewing BERA’s speech writing prior to communications push.
  7. Coordinates and manages media engagement by identifying stakeholders, finding out their concerns and reacting to these, by arranging meetings and events and drafting supporting information such as press releases and briefings.
  8. Writes drafts and edits materials while ensuring compliance with the Authority’s guidelines to format and publish approved materials on its website.
  9. Develops and manages the Unit’s Risk Management plan
  10. Lead the Authority’s Social Responsibility programs

  • Bachelor’s degree in communication, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or related fields and a Master’s would be an added advantage.

  • Relevant certification or membership with a professional registered body will be an added advantage.

About the Role

As Chief Financial Officer (CFO) you will provide strategic financial leadership across our hybrid financial institution encompassing commercial and development banking, insurance brokerage, and fund administration. You will drive financial strategy, governance, and value management, ensuring fiscal sustainability, compliance, and alignment with the Bank’s long-term strategic objectives, ESG goals, and operational transformation initiatives.

  • Strategic Financial Leadership: Lead the Group’s financial strategy, providing strategic advice to the CEO, Board, and ExCo to support growth, investment, and capital optimisation.
  • Financial Resource Management: Oversee liquidity, capital structure, funding, and financial planning to ensure solvency, sustainability, and efficient working capital management.
  • Financial Performance Management: Drive financial performance through cost discipline, resource optimisation, and delivery of key metrics including ROE, ROA, and cost efficiency.
  • Financial Reporting and Governance: Ensure accurate, compliant, and timely financial reporting, strong internal controls, and effective audit and governance oversight across the Group.
  • Procurement and Value Management: Provide strategic oversight of procurement to optimise value, cost efficiency, ESG compliance, and transparent sourcing practices.
  • Fund Administration: Oversee fund administration and cross-border financial operations, supporting investor relations, capital pooling, and regulatory compliance.
  • ESG and Sustainable Finance Integration: Embed ESG and sustainable finance principles into financial management, procurement, investment frameworks, and reporting.
  • Leadership and Organisational Development: Lead and develop high-performing finance and procurement teams while representing the institution with key stakeholders and regulators.

Requirements

  • Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA, or equivalent, with a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline; a postgraduate degree (MBA, MSc Finance) or FCA/FCCA/FCPA is preferred.
  • Minimum of 12 years’ experience in financial management, including at least 5 years in executive leadership or senior management within financial services.
  • Proven expertise in financial strategy, capital management, cross-border financing, procurement governance, and fund administration.
  • Knowledge of ESG integration and sustainable finance instruments is advantageous.

openings.title: Grade Controller
openings.description:
Grade Controller 1 Ref:271

Key Performance Areas

Ensure effective sampling and sample preparation processes are followed.

  • To ensure samples are split, collected and packaged as directed by the SFR sampling procedure.
  • To ensure sampling equipment is well looked after and ready for use at any time.
  • Ensure sampling consumables e.g. sieves, chip trays, sample bags, markers and tags are prepared well in time before drilling/sampling.
  • Ensure holes pegged by survey are not disturbed before drilling.
  • Ensure that the holes are drilled according to the planned surveys and report any non-compliance to the Geology Technicians guided by the relevant procedure.
  • Ensure sample sheets and drill-maps are correct and checked against pegged holes before actual sampling and that data has been captured and validated before samples are bagged for submitting to the laboratory.
  • Ensure that ore block polygon demarcation consumables e.g. coloured tapes, and flitch maps are prepared well in time before ore blasts and mark-out.
  • To ensure that ore blocks are marked out as per relevant procedure.
  • Ensure correct colour coded material card boards are visible in the ore haulage trucks before the trucks leave the ore block being mined.
  • To ensure safe conditions at the ROM pad and implement corrective actions where necessary prior to commencement of daily task (actively part-take in JHAs and take 5s). reporting any defects to the ROM pad supervisor and Geology Technicians.
  • Ensure that all stockpiling and re-handling is carried out as prescribed by standard procedures and protocols, with correct colour coded material sign boards in place for identification of individual ore stockpiles.
  • Ensure material is mined from correct location to correct destination by keeping continuous communication between RM pad and the in-pit grade controller.
  • Inform supervisors of ROM pad situation and prioritise activities to safely maximise production of plant feed.
  • Act as communication link between Process plant, ROM Pad operations and Mining Teams.
  • Keeping records of all documents as evidence of daily Tally of Ore feeding, RoM ore stockpiling, Blending and Down times of equipment.
  • Ensure deviations are reported promptly.
  • To ensure proper changeover/handover between shifts.
  • Other duties as per operational requirements and as assigned by supervision.
  • Ensure compliance to Sandfire’s Safety, Health and Environment standards & procedures.

Qualifications:  

  • JC or BGCSE (highly desirable)
  • Valid Light Duty Vehicles Driver’s License.

Experience:

  • At least 1 year of open pit mining experience with Geological sampling & production exposure.

Behavioural Competencies:

  • Team Player.
  • Proactive.
  • Time Management
  • Attention to detail
  • Effective Communication Skills
  • Interpersonal Skills
  • Decisive
  • Tenacious

  • Performs comprehensive pre-start and visual inspections on all assigned machinery and equipment (excavators, dump trucks, drill rigs, and dozers) to identify defects, assess operational readiness, and report findings to the supervisor as required.
  • Spots, signals, and directs haul trucks into and out of loading positions to maintain safe traffic flow and loading efficiency.
  • Loads material into haul trucks in accordance with standard operating procedures, ensuring correct payload, minimal spillage, and equipment protection.
  • Operates dump trucks to haul material safely and efficiently to designated tipping or ROM locations, in compliance with haul road rules and speed limits.
  • Operates dozers to clean loading areas, maintain safe working floors, manage spillage, and assist in achieving and maintaining correct bench and floor elevations.
  • Operates drill rigs in accordance with approved drilling patterns, depths, and procedures to support effective blasting outcomes.
  • Coordinates and directs support equipment to maintain clean, safe, and productive loading and working areas.
  • Maintains correct floor and bench levels through the use of applicable machine systems, visual indicators, and guidance from supervisors or survey controls.
  • Performs routine housekeeping and minor manual tasks, including cleaning of the cab and external machine components, to ensure safe and ergonomic working conditions.
  • Trams machines between work sites safely and efficiently in accordance with mine traffic rules and approved procedures.
  • Guides fuel and water bowsers into safe positions for refuelling and refilling activities, ensuring adherence to safety and environmental controls.
  • Disembarks from machinery for rest and refreshment strictly in line with site safety procedures.
  • Interacts effectively with fleet management and monitoring systems to record production data, report delays, and communicate operational information.
  • Provides on-the-job training and coaching to trainee and junior operators, ensuring adherence to safe work practices, operating standards, and productivity requirements

BGCSE and valid specific MTTC Machine operator certificate (Excavator,  Drill Rig & Dump Truck).

openings.title: Camp general Manager
openings.description:
• Key Responsibilties
    All Agents/Site Inspections /Journalists are to be hosted by the General Manager.
  • Act as a brand ambassador at all times, ensuring that any trips happen as seamlessly as possible.
  • Meet and host all guests visiting camp, gathering as much information. All guests should be asked about their stay, including their guide, room, and food.
  • Ensure all guests receive a safety and camp orientation debrief, signing the Indemnity & Waiver form in full.
  • Empower departmental managers by constant communication and meetings in which areas of focus are discussed.
  • Set quarterly objectives with each manager, ensuring they do the same for their teams.
  • Assist in any shortfalls in team numbers and respective work as required.
  • Ensure accountability of managers for respective departments or work done.
  • Constantly drive inter-departmental co-operation
  • Create team spirit by leading by example, listening, being emphatic, and motivating your team.
  • To ensure that you work with the staff committee to effectively solve and assist in any staff issues that may arise.
  • Time management to be implemented in conjunction with departmental managers, in all departments of camp operations with necessary shift rosters being utilised.
  • Record all ANSAR for staff timeously and submit to town by month end.
  • Plan all staff leave and subsequent movements in and out of camp on time.
  • Evaluate and implement optimum staff numbers in all departments, to effectively streamline work in the lodge.
  • Ensure succession plans are managed for all departments.
  • Drive staff training through departmental managers, constantly evaluating and re-assessing staff with potential, or in need of assistance, mentoring, and development.
  • Familiarise yourself with company procedures, ensuring that any corrective or disciplinary procedures are utilized as per company standards, in necessary situations.
  • General Staff meetings to be held monthly, with minutes to be submitted to HR, Concession, and OPS management.
  • Bi-annual appraisals must be followed for all camp staff.
  • Motivate staff to utilize training platforms and attend in-house training courses, monitoring their performance.
  • Familiarize yourself with all aspects of camp administration, contracts & emergency procedures.
  • Delegate and assist with all camp administration effectively throughout departments, ensuring deadlines are adhered to
  • Personally check WISH and rooming allocations in advance, ensuring WISH queries are submitted every Sunday to the relevant Travel shop consultant in town.
  • Ensure all Guest information is captured on the Wilderness Window timeously, making sure that in-depth information is inputted, and if applicable, sent on to the subsequent camps guests are visiting.
  • Monitor and maintain constant input of guest information on the MOOD boards, ensuring all interesting and relevant information is discussed in every morning meeting.
  • All guest and staff medical incidents to be reported to Wilderness24
  • WS24 forms to be filled in by yourself for any larger staff medical incidents, as well as any damage or destruction to assets and company property.
  • Oversee Month-end stocktakes and sheets, personally checking for any large discrepancies or mistakes.
  • Submit Wage Memos for both Senior and Junior staff to the relevant payroll person as per the time frame stipulated by them. You should ensure that any necessary charges or deductions are captured on this, as per company standards.
  • Write a newsletter for your camp at the end of each month, as per the prescribed format.
  • Double-check all bulk orders before they are sent to town on the 28thof each Month, utilizing the stock takes, par stock, and projected occupancies to ensure that all orders are within prescribed levels.
  • Ensure All Medical Kits (including guides) are stocked adequately, with all items being checked monthly for expiration dates. Any medical orders are to be placed on the 15thof each month.
  • Monitor stationary usage, and place orders on the 15thof each month.
  • Make sure all Departmental Heads and Managers, including yourself, leave detailed handover notes before going on leave. These are to be submitted to relevant Concession and OPS managers.
  • Timeously respond, or ensure response to any queries submitted by Operational support.
  • Ensure the required monthly environmental data is captured, correct and submitted by the 10thof the following month.
  • Manage by Walking Around. Ensure you walk through the camp daily, making sure all areas are kept to the highest possible standard. This includes visiting the staff village regularly.
  • Ensure adherence to Minimum standards at all times.
  • Constantly evaluate areas that may need attention within the concession and camp, submitting necessary feedback to the Maun office to allow for planning.
  • Continuously drive Service standards, monitoring work ethic, neatness and skill sets.
  • Support the Curio Shop & Spa Managers in their daily operations.
  • Curb any excessive expenditure or wastage in all departments.
  • Ensure all company assets are maintained and cared for in an appropriate manner.
  • Communicate with your direct Manager (Concession or OPS Manager) regularly or as required.
  • Drive personalized guest experience as much as possible, with a minimum of one signature activity per guest per stay and a magic moment per day.
  • Familiarise yourself with the rules and regulations about operations within National Parks and/or your concessions Technical Proposal, ensuring adherence to these where applicable.
  • Take responsibility and ownership of the entire camp operation.
  • Work closely with 3rdparties like the BDF and Parks by reporting problem animal and guest/staff safety-related incidents promptly.
  • Be actively involved in the Environmental Management Systems (EMS) of the camp by assisting in the formulation of improvement timelines and ensuring the provided timelines are met.
  • Understand and articulate Wilderness’ Impact Strategy, including the mission, 2030 goals, and three Impact Pillars.
  • Communicate Impact to guests by linking their visit to local projects and in-camp products.
  • Explain the “why” behind sustainable practices and direct guests toward supporting Impact through repeat travel or donations.
  • Educate and engage staff on their role in Impact, conservation efforts, and adherence to sustainability policies.
  • Facilitate back-of-house tours showcasing sustainable technologies, ensuring staff can answer guest questions confidently.
  • Ensure GEMS adherence across all camp operations, using the latest standards as the baseline for compliance.
  • Oversee operational implementation of GEMS in water, waste, energy, and field systems to minimise environmental impact.
  • Ensure EMS Improvement Timelines are adhered to and met.
  • Conduct regular inspections of camp and staff village, checking waste systems, fuel storage, water reticulation, power supply, hot water, and chemical use.
  • Maintain reporting and documentation of all environmental data and critical maintenance, submitting timely reports to sustainability teams.
  • Train and hold staff accountable for GEMS compliance, including firefighting, waste separation, and eco-friendly product use.
  • Identify and resolve problems by addressing leaks, contamination, invasive species, and waste disposal issues, while liaising with the Regional Environmental Manager.
  • Integrate GEMS into daily management using the EMS checklist and incorporating environmental updates into team meetings.
  • Ensure STP inspections are regularly carried out and coordinate closely with TSM and responsible personnel.
  • Ensure your own legal, medical, and other insurance documents are kept valid.
  • Complete any other task as delegated to you by the Concession / Operations or Senior management within the company.
  • Requirements
  • A National Diploma in Tourism Management or equivalent.
  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience within the hospitality industry.
  • Experience in handling international guests and seasoned travelers will give an added advantage.
  • Lodge Management background and knowledge of the Safari lodge business is preferable.
  • Computer skills (MS Office suite).
  • Outstanding communication skills.
  • Service excellence (Desire to enhance Guest Experience).
  • Integrity.
  • Problem solving.
  • Empathy.
  • Organizational Skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours

openings.title: Human Resources Officer
openings.description:
HUMAN RESOURCES OFFICER

The Southern African Development Community Accreditation Services (SADCAS) is a multi-economy accreditation body established in terms of Article 15 B of the Technical Barriers to Trade (TBT) Annex to the SADC Protocol on Trade with the primary purpose of ensuring that conformity assessment service providers operating in those SADC Member States which do not have national accreditation bodies are subject to oversight by an authoritative body.

SADCAS services the accreditation needs of 14 SADC Member States, namely: Angola; Botswana; Comoros; Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC); Eswatini; Lesotho; Madagascar; Malawi; Mozambique; Namibia; Seychelles; Tanzania; Zambia; and Zimbabwe. SADCAS plays a key role in trade facilitation and the protection of health, safety, and the environment.

The following post, tenable in Gaborone, is currently on offer: Human Resources Officer

MAIN PURPOSE OF THE JOB

To function as a strategic partner supporting the organisation's human capital needs through effective implementation of HR policies, systems, and procedures. The Human Resources Officer ensures compliance with SADCAS requirements, facilitates talent management processes, and supports organisational capability development. The Officer advises and recommends on HR matters in compliance with relevant laws.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Recruitment & Selection

  • Draft job adverts aligned with approved job descriptions.
  • Facilitate induction and onboarding programmes for new employees.

Performance Management

  • Implement Performance Management System
  • Coordinate performance contract reviews, performance appraisals and recommend training interventions.

Industrial Relations

  • Provide advisory support on the Code of Conduct and labour laws.
  • Review employment practices for compliance.

Human Resources Budgets

  • Compile HR budgets and training plans.
  • Apply HR planning best practices.

Employee Wellness

  • Administer employee benefits and wellness initiatives.

Human Resources Administration

  • Assist with HR policy development and reviews to ensure consistent application.
  • Establish HR best practices
  • Prepare regular reports

Payroll Administration

  • Oversee payroll and benefits administration

Safety, Health and Environment (SHE)

  • Ensure compliance with SHE requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Degree in Human Resources Management or Social Sciences.
  • Membership with a recognised HR professional body.
  • Minimum 5 years relevant experience in HR roles.
  • Competence in HR administration, recruitment, performance management and payroll oversight.
  • Computer literacy (MS Office).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organisational and analytical skills.

REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

  • Results oriented
  • Time management
  • Analytical thinking
  • People management skills
  • Risk-based thinking
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Integrity and ability to maintain confidentiality

SUBMISSION

Interested and suitably qualified candidates who are up for the challenge are encouraged to email a motivational letter, CV (maximum 3 pages) and certified copies of qualifications to: recruitment@sadcas.org

This position is responsible for managing community economic opportunities by liaising with different communities in the field of agriculture, tourism, and manufacturing industries by planning, developing, coordinating, implementing and evaluating a range of community/economic development projects initiated by and in support of communities by the Company within the SPEDU Region.

Facilitation of Community Based Projects

  • Economic Analysis and Research: Conduct in-depth research, surveys, and data collection on local economic conditions, such as employment rates, income levels, demographic shifts, and industry trends. They analyze this data to identify regional growth opportunities, strengths, and weaknesses.
  • Strategic Planning and Development: Formulate and implement strategic plans to attract new businesses, retain existing ones, and create jobs. This includes developing initiatives for community revitalization and infrastructure planning.
  • Policy Advising and Implementation: Provide expert analysis and advice to local governments, non-profits, or agencies regarding economic policies, tax incentives, and regulatory compliance.
  • Stakeholder Engagement and Liaison: Serve as a bridge between businesses, government officials, community organizations, and residents to facilitate collaboration, negotiate agreements, and streamline development projects.
  • Funding and Resource Acquisition: Identify, apply for, and secure funding through grants, loans, and private donations to support community projects.
  • Impact Assessment and Reporting: Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of economic programs by preparing reports, using GIS mapping for spatial data analysis, and presenting findings to stakeholders.
  • Facilitates community clusters for land allocation; Provides support for entrepreneurship development;Addresses barriers to business start-up and growth;

Training and Capacity Building of Community Projects

  • Identifies training needs and coordinates relevant workshops for community-based organisations;

The Senior Executive, Industrial Relations is responsible for managing and strengthening labour relations, workplace harmony, and compliance with labour legislation across SPEDU and its operations within the SPEDU region. The role ensures that employment relationships are managed in a fair, transparent, and legally compliant manner, while proactively mitigating labour-related risks that could affect organisational performance, reputation, and service delivery.

The position plays a critical role in maintaining industrial peace, supporting organisational transformation, and enabling a productive and engaged workforce aligned with SPEDU's mandate.

  • Establish a structured and proactive industrial relations environment within the SPEDU region.
  • Ensure full compliance with labour legislation and best practice among all firms operating within SPEDU.
  • Facilitate SPEDU companies resolve labour disputes efficiently and minimise operational disruption.
  • Build constructive relationships with trade unions and employee representatives.
  • Ensures labour stability during organisational change.
  • Promote a positive and productive work environment.
  • Ensures visibility and control over industrial relations risks.

Governance, Risk and Compliance Responsibilities

  • Ensure adherence to ethical standards, confidentiality, and procedural fairness.
  • Escalate high-risk or sensitive labour issues to Management.

Experience: 7 years in industrial relations or labour law practice.

openings.title: Specialist: Manufacturing Value Chains Development
openings.description:
SPECIALIST: MANUFACTURING VALUE CHAINS DEVELOPMENT

The Specialist, Manufacturing Value Chains Development enhances industrial competitiveness by analyzing, upgrading, and optimizing production processes from raw materials to end-market delivery. The specialist works with firms to identify bottlenecks, foster market linkages for producers, and implement strategic interventions to increase profitability, efficiency, and sustainability within specific sectors. responsible for maximizing the local value addition, employment, and industrial capacity derived from natural resources or industrial projects. They further focus on turning raw materials or economic activity into higher-value products and local economic opportunities, rather than just exporting raw materials or labor.

Key Responsibilities and Functions

  • Value Chain Analysis & Mapping: Conducting detailed studies of production, processing, and marketing to identify constraints, opportunities, and market access gaps.
  • Formulating Beneficiation Strategies: Designing, implementing, and monitoring frameworks that encourage local processing of raw materials (e.g., mineral, agricultural) to increase their value before export.
  • Policy Advice: Providing expert technical advice to government, industry, or corporate leadership regarding regulations for socioeconomic agreements, local content policies, and industrial strategies.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring that industrial or resource projects comply with local content requirements, socioeconomic agreements, and environmental regulations.
  • Upgrading Strategies: Developing and implementing technical strategies to enhance product quality, improve technology adoption, and increase value addition.
  • Market Linkages & Partnerships: Facilitates relationships between producers, SMMEs, and buyers, including organizing trade dialogues and supporting business investment.
  • Capacity Building: Training, mentoring, and offering technical assistance to stakeholders to strengthen competitiveness and sustainability.
  • Investment & Policy Support: Developing business plans to secure financing, analyzing trade policies, and providing inputs for policy improvements.
  • Land Facilitation: Manages the facilitation of land allocation process for investors (acquisition and leases);
  • Data management: Manage, maintains the development and provision of data base for project planning and management in Manufacturing and Industry;
  • Policy Review: Review the main existing manufacturing value chains in the region including market trends, technological and infrastructure status, market demand and supply, primary actors and their roles and linkages, post-harvest/production handling, business support service needs (including capacity building), and regulatory and control mechanisms.
  • Job Creation: Identification of possible improvements that can lead to significant increases in employment and income.

Education/Qualifications: A Degree in Technical field such as Engineering (Electrical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Mechanical) or Technology (Industrial Design, Technology). A Master's Degree in any of the above disciplines will be an added advantage.

Experience: Proven experience in a value chains development,with experience in supply chain management, market systems development (MSD), or Making Markets Work for the Poor (M4P) approaches.

Technical Skills: Proficiency in data analysis, report writing, and strategic planning. Industry 4.0.

Competencies: Strong networking abilities, team management, and ability to work with both private and public sectors. Strategic Thinking. Planning and Organising

Remuneration
SPEDU offers a competitive salary package to the successful candidates.

data.name: AOBAKWE PHENYO MASWABI CV
data.summary:
I am a passionate, solutions-driven IT graduate holding a Bachelor of Science (Honors) in Network Security and Computer Forensics from Botho University, Botswana. My journey has been fueled by a deep curiosity for cybersecurity, a strong commitment to technical excellence, and a genuine desire to make technology more accessible, secure, and impactful.

Through both academic and professional engagements, I have built a solid foundation in technical support, cybersecurity awareness, and customer relationship management. While serving as an IT Support Intern at Educational Computer Services (ECS) and later as a Data Indexing Consultant with the Bank of Botswana, I consistently resolved complex user issues—achieving a 90% first-contact resolution rate and a 95% customer satisfaction score. I take pride in my ability to bridge the gap between complex IT systems and end-user understanding, simplifying processes and enhancing digital confidence.

Beyond the workplace, I actively contributed to the Botho University IT Club as a Cybersecurity Advocate, where I led digital literacy workshops, facilitated hands-on training in basic network security, and empowered both students and staff to better understand and navigate digital threats. These volunteer experiences not only deepened my technical skillset but also instilled a strong sense of responsibility toward community-driven tech education.

With every opportunity, I strive to blend technical knowledge with communication, adaptability, and a growth mindset—qualities I believe are essential in today’s fast-evolving digital landscape. I am excited to continue this journey of learning, contributing, and innovating in the IT and cybersecurity space.
